caption: The top path is full virtualization: an unmodified guest trips over a privileged instruction and the VMM emulates it. The bottom path is para-virtualization: the edited guest calls the VMM on purpose, so no decode is needed.

spec.title: Trap versus hypercall
spec.aria: Two flows: an unmodified guest traps to the VMM which emulates the instruction; a modified guest issues a hypercall that the VMM handles directly.
